entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: A religious sect in Sarpadia founded by Tourach that welcomed humans and non-humans, opposed Phyrexia and warred with Icatia.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: Continent where the Order was based.

entities.name: Tourach
entities.description: Founder of the Order, deified after his death.

entities.name: Ebon Praetor
entities.description: Figure the Order worshiped before Tourach.

entities.name: Icatia
entities.description: Realm at war with the Order.

entities.name: Order of Leitbur
entities.description: Icatian order and sworn enemy of the Ebon Hand.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: Figure the Ebon Hand may originally have worshipped as a cult.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Opposed by the Ebon Hand.

entities.name: Endrek Sahr
entities.description: Prominent Order wizard who created thrulls and was ordered executed for the Derelor; pulled into the future by a time rift.

entities.name: Thrulls
entities.description: Slaves and ritual sacrifices created by Endrek Sahr through necromancy and alchemy.

entities.name: Vaylesh
entities.description: Priestess of the Order who captured Tymolin Loneglade.

entities.name: Tymolin Loneglade
entities.description: Captured by Vaylesh and killed by Oliver Farrel.

entities.name: Oliver Farrel
entities.description: Farrelite lured by Vaylesh into open combat.

entities.name: Tev Loneglade
entities.description: Planeswalker who killed the Ebon Hand troops with a Fireball and became Tevesh Szat.

entities.name: Thrull Rebellion
entities.description: Uprising by intelligent thrull wizards.

entities.name: Jherana Rure
entities.description: Led military resistance against the Thrulls and was killed by Necrites.

entities.name: Necrites
entities.description: Thrulls who killed Rure and overran the continent.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: Claimed to be Master of the Ebon Hand.

entities.name: Thurzen Klathe
entities.description: Lord High Priest of the Order.

entities.name: Ivra Jursdotter
entities.description: Mercenary member of the Order.

events.summary: Endrek Sahr creates thrulls to serve as slaves and ritual sacrifices.
events.quote: created Thrulls to serve them as slaves and ritual sacrifices

events.summary: Thrulls breed rapidly and overwhelm the Order; Sahr is ordered executed but a time rift pulls him into the future.
events.quote: A time rift seemed to be the only reprieve for Sahr, as he was pulled into the future

events.summary: Vaylesh captures Tymolin Loneglade and lures Oliver Farrel to combat to draw the Farrelites into the open.
events.quote: Vaylesh , a priestess of the Order of the Ebon Hand, captured Tymolin Loneglade

events.summary: Farrel kills Tym; Tev Loneglade kills all the troops with a Fireball and transforms into Tevesh Szat.
events.quote: When Farrel killed Tym, the planeswalker Tev Loneglade killed all the troops present with a massive Fireball .

events.summary: The thrull wizards spark the Thrull Rebellion; Jherana Rure leads resistance until Necrites kill her.
events.quote: Necrites eventually killed Rure and ended the resistance in a single blow.
